ov: The most abundant and widespread primate: an upright-walking ape with little body hair and a large, complex brain that allows technology, culture and language. Humans arose in Africa about 300,000 years ago, now live worldwide, and form social groups from families to nations.
rg: Worldwide. Homo sapiens arose in Africa about 300,000 years ago and spread from there.
df: Almost anything: diets range from purely vegan to mostly meat, and humans cook their food with fire.
fx: Humans have about 2 million sweat glands, far more than chimpanzees, which helps on long runs.
A person can survive up to eight weeks without food, but only three or four days without water.
